name: Singapore
summary: Plan outdoor districts early and late, using galleries or conservatories for the hottest hours. Marina Bay, Chinatown and Little India each make coherent walking clusters.
seasonNote: Hot and humid year-round; sudden rain is normal, and late-year monsoon weather can be wetter.
arrival: Changi is linked to the MRT with a transfer at Tanah Merah; taxis are simpler with heavy luggage.
gettingAround: MRT and buses cover most visits; contactless payment is useful, with foreign-card fees possible.
cashTip: Keep SGD for hawker stalls and small vendors; card acceptance is widespread elsewhere.
foodTip: Hawker centres are ideal for chicken rice, laksa and roti prata; halal-certified and vegetarian stalls are available.
buyTip: Look for local design, tea and kaya; check liquids and food-import limits.
baseArea: Bugis/City Hall for central links or Chinatown for food.

connections.note: Airborne time only; a coach takes much longer and border queues vary.
Approximate flight to Denpasar plus road transfer to Ubud; traffic can add hours.
